text:
Analysts See $1.77 EPS for NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NXPI) Posted by Jeanette Kaplan on January 3, 2019 at 2:33 am
Analysts expect NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) to report $1.77 EPS on February, 6.They anticipate $1.29 EPS change or 42.16 % from last quarter’s $3.06 EPS. NXPI’s profit would be $523.05 million giving it 10.60 P/E if the $1.77 EPS is correct. After having $1.81 EPS previously, NXP Semiconductors N.V.’s analysts see -2.21 % EPS growth. The stock increased 2.39% or $1.75 during the last trading session, reaching $75.03. About 4.72M shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has declined 33.99% since January 3, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.99% the S&P500. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) Ratings Coverage
Among 16 analysts covering NXP Semiconductors ( NASDAQ:NXPI ), 10 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 63% are positive. NXP Semiconductors had 20 analyst reports since July 26, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating by SunTrust given on Friday, July 27. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Citigroup on Friday, November 2. The rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus on Friday, July 27 with “Hold”. The stock has “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Friday, July 27. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Credit Suisse given on Friday, September 7. Bank of America upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Monday, September 17 report. The rating was upgraded by Barclays Capital to “Overweight” on Tuesday, October 23. Mizuho upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Friday, July 27 report. Morgan Stanley maintained the shares of NXPI in report on Thursday, July 26 with “Equal-Weight” rating. Morgan Stanley maintained it with “Equal-Weight” rating and $100 target in Wednesday, October 3 report.
NXP Semiconductors N.V., a semiconductor company, provides high performance mixed signal and standard product solutions for radio frequency , analog, power management, interface, security, and digital processing products worldwide. The company has market cap of $22.17 billion. It offers products for audio and visual head-end unit applications, such as single-chip radio solutions, audio amplifiers and power analog products, and i.MX applications processors; and in-vehicle networking products, two-way secure entry products, and various sensors and microcontrollers, as well as power management solutions. It has a 9.54 P/E ratio. The firm also provides secure identification solutions comprising passive RF connectivity devices; microcontroller devices; and secure real-time operating system software products to facilitate the encryption-decryption of data, and the interaction with the reader infrastructure systems.
